displayName: See what your competitors are posting and what's getting traction
summary: Find out what content is working for your competitors so you can do it better.

useCases.title: See what your competitors are posting and what's getting traction
useCases.message: Help me track what my competitors are posting and what is performing. You might want to start by identifying my top competitors from what you know about my company and product. Then go through their LinkedIn profiles and recent posts, pull engagement data, and give me a breakdown of what topics and formats are getting the most traction.
